entity_labels.disease: A disease, disorder, syndrome, or diagnosed medical condition.
entity_labels.symptom: A symptom, sign, complaint, or clinical manifestation experienced by a patient.
entity_labels.risk factor: An exposure, comorbidity, trait, or circumstance associated with higher or lower disease risk.
entity_labels.biomarker: A measurable biological, imaging, or laboratory marker used to indicate disease or physiology.
entity_labels.drug: A medication, pharmaceutical compound, or administered therapeutic substance.
entity_labels.treatment: A treatment, intervention, therapy, procedure, or clinical management strategy.
entity_labels.gene: A gene, allele, genetic variant, mutation, or named genomic locus.
entity_labels.anatomy: A body part, organ, tissue, cell type, brain region, or anatomical structure.
entity_labels.demographic: A population attribute or subgroup such as age, sex, ethnicity, education, or socioeconomic status.
entity_labels.lifestyle: A lifestyle behavior or habit such as exercise, diet, smoking, alcohol use, or sleep.
entity_labels.outcome: A clinical, cognitive, functional, or survival outcome, endpoint, or measured result.
entity_labels.study: A study, trial, cohort, dataset, or other research design or evidence source.
